title: Rockstar Devs Comment on Their Next Game After GTA 6
description: According to GameRant, two Rockstar developers have recently commented on the studio's next video game release following Grand Theft Auto 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Looking Beyond GTA 6: Rockstar's Future Plans

As anticipation for *Grand Theft Auto 6* reaches unprecedented heights across the global gaming community, the future roadmap of Rockstar Games continues to be a hot topic of discussion. Recently, according to a report by gaming outlet GameRant, two Rockstar developers shared comments regarding the studio's next video game project following the release of *GTA 6*.

As one of the most prominent developers in the video game industry, every strategic move made by Rockstar draws immense attention from fans and media alike. While the vast majority of player focus remains squarely fixed on the upcoming launch of *GTA 6*, the developers' remarks offer a glimpse into the long-term vision of the studio. Although the source report did not disclose specific titles, genres, or release windows, these comments indicate that the team looks well beyond their current monumental release when planning ahead.

## Industry Context and Fan Perspective

Looking back at Rockstar's release history, massive gaps between major titles have become the norm, with each game serving as a generational milestone in technical achievement and open-world design. Industry analysis suggests that discussing post-launch or future pipelines during major development cycles is a standard part of studio management, though fans should remember that no official project details or timelines were revealed in this instance.

## Editor's Take

It is always intriguing to hear developers from a top-tier studio like Rockstar glance toward the future. While *GTA 6* remains the absolute priority for the community, knowing that the studio is already thinking about what comes next highlights their long-term commitment to creating blockbuster experiences.
